references.text: Both verses describe the same sequence of events: Joseph's transfer to prison and his role there.
Both verses illustrate Joseph's ability to find favor and gain responsibility (service) with his superior, regardless of whether he is free or a prisoner.
The verses are directly connected; 40:4 describes the action (service), while 39:21 explains the divine cause (the Lord's goodwill).
Thematic parallel: The unjust imprisonment of God's servants who nevertheless gain a role with responsibility or influence while in custody.
Verse 39:1 introduces Potiphar (the captain of the guard), who is the highest authority behind the prison warden mentioned in 40:4.
